name: What materials are best for shower walls in a conversion?

mainEntity.name: What materials are best for shower walls in a conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: For shower walls, popular material choices include ceramic or porcelain tiles, which offer extensive design versatility and durability. Acrylic or fiberglass surrounds are a more economical and low-maintenance option, providing a seamless, grout-free surface. For a premium look, natural stone like marble or granite can be used, though it requires more maintenance and sealing. Each material offers different aesthetic, durability, and maintenance characteristics, allowing you to choose based on your budget and design preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular materials include ceramic/porcelain tile for versatility, acrylic/fiberglass for economy and low maintenance, or natural stone for a premium look.
